stories.title: Budget 2027 : le Medef évalue à "près de 20 milliards d'euros" les prélèvements et taxes touchant les entreprises

en.title: Budget 2027: Medef estimates "nearly 20 billion euros" in levies and taxes affecting companies
en.summary: The French government unveiled a 2027 budget plan requiring 54 billion euros in savings, with 43 billion from new measures. Business groups estimate companies will face nearly 20 billion euros in new taxes and levies.

stories.title: Retraites : dans le projet du gouvernement, seules les pensions jusqu’à 1 260 euros sont indexées sur l’inflation à ce stade

en.title: Pensions: in the government's plan, only pensions up to 1,260 euros are indexed to inflation at this stage
en.summary: The government plans to save 4 billion euros by limiting inflation adjustments to pensions below 1,260 euros while freezing higher pensions and modifying a 10 percent tax deduction for retirees.

stories.title: Impôts, «effort» sur les dépenses, retraites… Ce que contient le projet de budget 2027 présenté ce jeudi par le gouvernement

en.title: Taxes, "effort" on spending, pensions... What the 2027 budget plan presented Thursday by the government contains
en.summary: Government ministers presented the 2027 budget bill featuring tax changes, spending reductions, and pension modifications as part of the fiscal adjustment plan.

stories.title: "J'ai pris les commandes et tiré, j'avais vu ça dans une série" : arrivés en Israël, les passagers du vol FlyDubai livrent leurs premiers témoignages sur l'attaque

en.title: "I took control and fired, I had seen it in a TV series": Israeli passengers from FlyDubai flight share first accounts of the attack
en.summary: Israeli passengers safely returned from an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after a hijacking attempt. Passengers have begun describing their experiences during the incident, though many details remain unclear.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement table sur des recettes fiscales en hausse de 48 milliards d’euros

en.title: 2027 Budget: government banking on 48 billion euros increase in tax revenues
en.summary: France's 2027 budget projects a significant rise in mandatory levies despite claims of fiscal stability, with new tax measures alone expected to generate 17 billion euros.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : «LFI et ses proxys de l’ultragauche» sont «à l’origine» selon Matignon, Bompard affirme que le gouvernement «sombre dans le complotisme»

en.title: High school blockades: "LFI and its far-left proxies" are "at the origin" according to Matignon, Bompard claims government "sinking into conspiracy theories"
en.summary: The French government blamed La France insoumise and allied far-left groups for organizing high school blockades, while LFI coordinator Manuel Bompard accused the government of promoting conspiracy theories.

stories.title: Salaire des fonctionnaires, retraites, santé… Ces 25 milliards d’euros d’économies « partiellement » détaillés dans le budget 2027

en.title: Civil service salaries, pensions, healthcare… These 25 billion euros in savings "partially" detailed in the 2027 budget
en.summary: The government's 2027 budget details partial breakdowns of 25 billion euros in planned savings across public sector wages, pensions, and health, following a preliminary Court of Accounts review.

stories.title: 54 Md d'économies : le gouvernement lève le voile sur son budget 2027

en.title: 54 billion in savings: government unveils its 2027 budget
en.summary: The French government is presenting its 2027 budget plan featuring 54 billion euros in savings, with analysis from a political scientist and think tank member.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement confirme l’augmentation de la TVA sur Canal +, malgré l’opposition du monde du cinéma

en.title: 2027 Budget: Government confirms VAT increase on Canal+, despite film industry opposition
en.summary: France's government proposed raising the VAT rate on Canal+ television and cinema channel from 10 to 20 percent in its 2027 budget bill presented October 1st, despite objections from the film sector.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le Haut Conseil des finances publiques juge «optimistes» les plans du gouvernement

en.title: 2027 Budget: High Council of Public Finance deems government plans "optimistic"
en.summary: France's High Council of Public Finance warned on October 1st that the government's 2027 budget projections are overly optimistic, noting that achieving a 5 percent deficit target depends on implementing all proposed measures.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement face à l’équation des 54 milliards

en.title: 2027 Budget: government facing the 54 billion euro equation
en.summary: The final budget of the Macron era is presented amid high deficits, record debt, and lack of parliamentary majority, with the government aiming for a 5 percent deficit in 2027 through 54 billion euros in spending reductions.

stories.title: Le gouvernement lève le voile sur son budget 2027, sous la pression des marchés

en.title: Government unveils 2027 budget under pressure from markets
en.summary: The government presented its 2027 budget proposal aimed at strengthening public finances through measures including pension reforms, as French debt interest rates rise sharply.

stories.title: Dette française : l’OAT frôle 5%, l’alerte demeure malgré le budget

en.title: French debt: OAT approaches 5%, alert remains despite budget
en.summary: France's ten-year bond yield nearly reached 5 percent on October 1st before declining to 4.83 percent following the 2027 budget presentation, yet concerns persist as the state faces record borrowing needs and interest expenses approaching 91 billion euros.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement mise plus sur des recettes nouvelles que sur des économies pour contenir le déficit

en.title: 2027 Budget: Government relies more on new revenue than spending cuts to contain deficit
en.summary: The government presented a 2027 budget on October 1st featuring 43 billion euros in spending reductions, but the High Council of Public Finance indicated the deficit reduction strategy depends primarily on tax increases rather than expense reductions.

stories.title: Gérard Larcher est réélu à la présidence du Sénat dès le premier tour

en.title: Gérard Larcher re-elected to the presidency of the Senate in the first round
en.summary: Gérard Larcher, a senator from Yvelines, was re-elected on Thursday to his sixth term as president of the Senate.

stories.title: Quand la Chine entraîne son avion spatial secret au kidnapping de satellite

en.title: China trains its secret space plane in satellite kidnapping
en.summary: China's CSSHQ space plane has been observed practicing the capture and release of a small satellite during its fourth flight in recent months, suggesting preparation for enemy satellite seizure.

stories.title: Électronique : comment le mastodonte chinois Hisense s'est armé pour défier coréens et japonais

en.title: Electronics: how Chinese giant Hisense armed itself to challenge South Koreans and Japanese
en.summary: Chinese electronics company Hisense is leveraging its vast domestic market, integrated industrial capacity, and two decades of international expansion to compete with established European and American players.
